statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once and put d_T=6-r_T for each actual triangle. Suppose R=226 and every d_T belongs to {0,1,2,3}. Then the number of actual triangles with deficiency three is not three.
assumptions: R=226 counts actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once
d_T=6-r_T belongs to {0,1,2,3} for every actual triangle

scope.description: Conditional exclusion of exactly three deficiency-three triangles at R226/maxd3.

exact_case_coverage.selected_family: O=D1 union D3, s=24-2b, all point incidences even

preserved_outline_boundaries: Selected incidences need not all be two or four; larger values are retained and strengthen K.
The b0 tentative equality route is replaced by the strict actual selected-edge lower bound ell>=15.
A four-D2 outside point is excluded by the independently forced bad-point count, not an assumed absence.
limitations: This statement does not supply the separate c<=3 theorem or the separate maxd3 conclusion.
No incidence equitability, automorphism, selected inducedness, positivity of unknown edges or forced nonconstant codeword is assumed.
The exact new full proof requires a different written gate; Root discovery agreement is not verification.
No R226 or target exclusion is claimed.
